title.zh: 卷一百〇四 列傳第四十二: 納坦謀嘉 鄒谷 高霖 孟奎 烏林荅與 郭俁 溫迪罕達 王擴 移剌福僧 奧屯忠孝 蒲察思忠 紇石烈胡失門 完顏宇 斡勒合打 蒲察移剌都
title.en: Volume 104 Biographies 42: Natan Moujia, Zou Gu, Gao Lin, Meng Kui, Wu Lindayu, Guo Yu, Wendi Handa, Wang Kuo, Yila Fuseng, Aotun Zhongxiao, Pucha Sizhong, Geshiliehushimen, Wan Yanyu, Wolei Heda, Puchayiladou
title.raw: 卷一百〇四 列傳第四十二: 納坦謀嘉 鄒谷 高霖 孟奎 烏林荅與 郭俁 溫迪罕達 王擴 移剌福僧 奧屯忠孝 蒲察思忠 紇石烈胡失門 完顏宇 斡勒合打 蒲察移剌都 Volume 104 Biographies 42: Natan Moujia, Zou Gu, Gao Lin, Meng Kui, Wu Lindayu, Guo Yu, Wendi Handa, Wang Kuo, Yila Fuseng, Aotun Zhongxiao, Pucha Sizhong, Geshiliehushimen, Wan Yanyu, Wolei Heda, Puchayiladou

sentences.zh: 納坦謀嘉

translations.literal: Natan Moujia
translations.idiomatic: Natan Moujia

sentences.zh: 納坦謀嘉，上京路牙塔懶猛安人。

translations.literal: Natan Moujia was a native of Yatalan Meng'an in Shangjing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Natan Moujia came from Yatalan Meng'an in Shangjing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 初習策論進士，大定二十六年，選入東宮，教鄆王琮、瀛王瑰讀書。

translations.literal: At first he studied for the policy-essay jinshi degree; in the twenty-sixth year of Dading he was selected to enter the Eastern Palace and taught the Prince of Yun, Cong, and the Prince of Ying, Gui, to read.
translations.idiomatic: He had first prepared for the policy-essay jinshi examination; in the twenty-sixth year of the Dading reign he was chosen for the Eastern Palace, where he instructed Princes Cong of Yun and Gui of Ying in their studies.

sentences.zh: 以終場舉人試補上京提刑司書史，以廉能著稱。

translations.literal: By passing the final session of the provincial examination he was appointed a clerk in the Shangjing Judicial Commission, and became renowned for integrity and competence.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the final round of the provincial examination he was made a clerk in the Shangjing Judicial Commission, where his integrity and ability won notice.

sentences.zh: 承安元年，契丹陀鎖寇掠韓州、信州，提刑司問諸書史誰入奏者，皆難之，謀嘉請行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Cheng'an, the Khitan Tuosuo raided Han and Xin prefectures; the Judicial Commission asked which of the clerks would enter a memorial, and all shrank from it, but Moujia volunteered to go.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Cheng'an, when the Khitan leader Tuosuo plundered Han and Xin prefectures, the Judicial Commission asked which clerk would present the memorial at court; everyone hesitated, but Moujia offered to go.

sentences.zh: 五年，特賜同進士出身，調東京教授、湯池主簿、太學助教。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was specially granted the status of one who had passed the jinshi with the same standing, and was transferred to professor at Dongjing, chief clerk at Tangchi, and assistant instructor at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was specially granted jinshi standing, then appointed professor at Dongjing, chief clerk at Tangchi, and assistant instructor at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，累除翰林修撰，兼修起居注、監察御史。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; when the mourning period ended he was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician for Compilation, and concurrently Compiler of the Diary of Activity and Attendance and Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother and completing the mourning period, he was promoted in succession to Hanlin Academician for Compilation, while also serving as Compiler of the Diary of Activity and Attendance and as Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，遷吏部員外郎、翰林待制、侍御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Hanlin Academician Awaiting Orders, and Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhenyou reign he was made Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Hanlin Academician Awaiting Orders, and Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 完顏宇舉謀嘉才行，志在匡國，可預軍政。

translations.literal: Wanyan Yu recommended Moujia for his talent and conduct, saying his will was to restore the state and that he could take part in military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Yu recommended Moujia for ability and character, saying he was intent on saving the state and could be entrusted with military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 充元帥府經歷官。

translations.literal: He was appointed administrative officer of the Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He served as administrative officer of the Marshal's Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 中都被圍，食且盡，胥鼎奏：「京師官民能贍足貧民者，計所贍遷官，皆先給據。」

translations.literal: When Zhongdu was besieged and food was nearly exhausted, Xu Ding memorialized: "Among the officials and people of the capital, those who can fully support the poor shall have their support counted toward promotion, and all shall first be given certificates."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongdu was under siege and provisions were nearly gone, Xu Ding memorialized: "Officials and commoners in the capital who can fully support the destitute shall have the amount of their charity counted toward promotion, and certificates shall be issued to them in advance."

sentences.zh: 謀嘉不受據而去。

translations.literal: Moujia would not accept a certificate and left.
translations.idiomatic: Moujia refused the certificate and walked away.

sentences.zh: 中都危急，謀嘉曰：「帥臣統數萬眾，不能出城一戰，何如自縛請降邪？」

translations.literal: Zhongdu was in grave peril; Moujia said: "The commander holds tens of thousands of men yet cannot fight one battle outside the walls—why not simply bind himself and ask to surrender?"
translations.idiomatic: With Zhongdu in dire straits, Moujia said: "The commander commands tens of thousands yet cannot fight a single sortie beyond the walls—might he not as well bind himself and sue for surrender?"

sentences.zh: 宣宗議遷都，謀嘉曰：「不可。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor discussed moving the capital; Moujia said: "That must not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xuanzong Emperor considered moving the capital, Moujia said: "That cannot be done.

sentences.zh: 河南地狹土薄，他日宋、夏交侵，河北非我有矣。

translations.literal: The lands of Henan are narrow and the soil thin; if one day Song and Xia attack together, Hebei will no longer be ours.
translations.idiomatic: Henan is cramped and its soil poor; if Song and Xia should attack together another day, Hebei will no longer be ours.

sentences.zh: 當選諸王分鎮遼東，河南，中都不可去也。」

translations.literal: Princes should be chosen to hold separate commands in Liaodong and Henan; the central capital must not be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: Select princes to hold separate commands in Liaodong and Henan—the central capital must not be left."

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: He was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: His advice was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 頃之，除唐州刺史。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Prefect of Tangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Prefect of Tangzhou.

sentences.zh: 入為太常少卿兼左拾遺，遷鄭州防禦使。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Vice Minister of Rites and concurrent Left Reminder, and was transferred to Defender of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Vice Minister of Rites with concurrent appointment as Left Reminder, then became Defender of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 改左諭德，轉少詹事，攝御史中丞，未幾，攝太子詹事。

translations.literal: He was changed to Left Mentor, then Junior Mentor, and acted as Vice Censor-in-Chief; before long he acted as Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Left Mentor, then Junior Mentor, acted as Vice Censor-in-Chief, and soon afterward acted as Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，潼關失守，遷河南統軍使兼昌武軍節度使，攝簽樞密院事，行院許州，汰去冗食軍士二千余人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding, when Tong Pass fell he was transferred to Commander of Henan with concurrent appointment as Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, and acted as signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he directed the bureau from Xuzhou and dismissed more than two thousand supernumerary soldiers on the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding, after Tong Pass was lost, he became Commander of Henan and concurrent Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, acting as signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he ran the bureau from Xuzhou and cut more than two thousand redundant soldiers from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 上書諫伐宋，不聽。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial advising against attacking Song; he was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against attacking Song, but was not listened to.

sentences.zh: 三年，降潁州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was demoted to Defender of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was demoted to Defender of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 有告宋人將襲潁州者，已而宋兵果至，謀嘉有備，乃引去。

translations.literal: Someone reported that Song troops would strike Yingzhou; soon afterward Song forces did arrive, but Moujia was prepared and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Someone warned that Song forces would raid Yingzhou; when Song troops came as predicted, Moujia was ready and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 有司上功，不及告者，謀嘉請而賞之。

translations.literal: The authorities reported merit but did not include the informant; Moujia requested that he be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: When the authorities submitted a merit report they omitted the informant; Moujia asked that he be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 四年，召為翰林侍講學士兼兵部侍郎，同修國史。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned as Hanlin Academician for Lectures with concurrent appointment as Vice Minister of War, and to compile the national history.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was recalled as Hanlin Academician for Lectures and Vice Minister of War, and to help compile the national history.

sentences.zh: 五年卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 鄒谷，字應仲，密州諸城人。

translations.literal: Zou Gu, style name Yingzhong, was a native of Zhucheng in Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zou Gu, courtesy name Yingzhong, was from Zhucheng in Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 中大定十三年進士第，累官沈王府文學。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination and rose through posts to Literary Scholar of the Prince of Shen's household.
translations.idiomatic: He took the jinshi in the thirteenth year of Dading and eventually became Literary Scholar in the household of the Prince of Shen.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏擬大理司直，上曰：「司直爭論情法，折正疑難，谷非所長也。」

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized proposing him as Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review; the emperor said: "The directorship disputes feeling and law and settles doubtful cases—Gu is not skilled in that."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat proposed him as Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review; the emperor said: "That post argues feeling against law and resolves doubtful cases—Gu is not suited to it."

sentences.zh: 宰臣曰：「穀有吏才，陝西、河南訪察及定課皆稱職。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers said: "Gu has talent as an administrator; in inspections in Shaanxi and Henan and in tax assessments he has performed his duties well."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers said: "Gu has administrative talent; in the Shaanxi and Henan inspections and in tax assessments he has done his work well."

sentences.zh: 上以穀為同知曹州軍州事。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Gu Associate Prefect of Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Gu Associate Prefect of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 召為刑部主事，轉北京、臨潢提刑判官，入為大理寺丞。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, transferred to Investigating and Judicial Commissioner of Beijing and Linhuang, and entered service as Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was called to the Ministry of Punishments as Principal Clerk, became Investigating and Judicial Commissioner for Beijing and Linhuang, and entered the Court of Judicial Review as Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 尚書省點差接送伴宋國使官，令史周昂具數員呈請。

translations.literal: The Secretariat assigned by roster the officials to escort and receive the Song envoys; the clerk Zhou Ang listed several candidates for approval.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat rostered officials to escort and receive the Song envoys; clerk Zhou Ang submitted several names for approval.

sentences.zh: 左司都事李炳乘醉見之，怒曰：「吾口舉兩人即是，安用許為？」

translations.literal: The Left Department Director Li Bing, seeing this while drunk, said in anger: "If I name two men with my mouth that is enough—what need for so many?"
translations.idiomatic: Left Department Director Li Bing, drunk when he saw the list, said angrily: "I can name two men with my mouth—that is enough; why so many?"

sentences.zh: 命左右攬昂衣欲杖之，會左司官召昂去乃已，詈諸令史為奴畜。

translations.literal: He ordered attendants to seize Ang by the robe intending to beat him; only when a Left Department official summoned Ang away did he stop, and he reviled the clerks as slave livestock.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his attendants to seize Ang by the robe to beat him; a Left Department official called Ang away and he stopped, cursing the clerks as slaves and beasts.

sentences.zh: 明日語權令史李秉鈞曰：「吾豈惟箠罵，汝進退去留，亦皆在我！」

translations.literal: The next day he told Acting Chief Clerk Li Bingjun: "Do I only beat and revile? Whether you advance, retreat, stay, or go is also in my hands!"
translations.idiomatic: The next day he told Acting Chief Clerk Li Bingjun: "Do you think I only beat and curse? Whether you rise, fall, stay, or leave is also in my hands!"

sentences.zh: 群吏將陳訴，會官劾奏，事下大理寺議，差接送伴官事當奏聞，炳謂口舉兩人，當科違制。

translations.literal: The clerks were about to lodge a complaint when an official impeached him; the matter went to the Court of Judicial Review for deliberation. Assigning escort officials for envoys should be reported to the throne; Bing had said he would name two men orally and should be punished for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The clerks were about to complain when an official impeached him; the case went to the Court of Judicial Review. Assigning escort officials for envoys required imperial report; Bing had said he would name two men orally and should be charged with violating regulations.

sentences.zh: 穀曰：「口舉兩人，一時之言，當杖贖。

translations.literal: Gu said: "Naming two men orally was a remark of the moment and should be punished by beating with redemption.
translations.idiomatic: Gu said: "Naming two men orally was a passing remark and should be punished by beating with redemption.

sentences.zh: 攬昂衣欲加杖，當決三十。」

translations.literal: Seizing Ang's robe intending to add beating should be thirty strokes with the rod."
translations.idiomatic: Seizing Ang's robe intending to beat him should draw thirty strokes of the rod."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「李炳讀書人，何乃至是？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Li Bing is a man of learning—how could he come to this?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Li Bing is a scholar—how could he come to this?"

sentences.zh: 宰臣對曰：「李炳疾惡，眾人不能容耳。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers replied: "Li Bing hates evil fiercely; the crowd simply cannot tolerate him."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers answered: "Li Bing hates wickedness fiercely; people simply cannot bear him."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「炳誠過矣，告者未必是也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Bing was indeed at fault, but the accusers are not necessarily right either."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Bing was truly in the wrong, but the accusers are not necessarily in the right."

sentences.zh: 乃從穀議。

translations.literal: The decision followed Gu's opinion.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted Gu's view.

sentences.zh: 曆濟南、彰德府治中，吏部郎中，河東按察副使，沂州防禦使。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Administrative Assistant of Jinan and Zhangde prefectures, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Vice Commissioner of the Hedong Investigation Commission, and Defender of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Administrative Assistant in Jinan and Zhangde, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Vice Commissioner of the Hedong Investigation Commission, and Defender of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 曆定海、泰甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: He served as Military Commissioner of Dinghai and Taining armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was Military Commissioner of the Dinghai and Taining armies.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Taihe he retired.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初卒。

translations.literal: He died at the beginning of Zhenyou.
translations.idiomatic: He died early in the Zhenyou reign.

sentences.zh: 高霖，字子約，東平人。

translations.literal: Gao Lin, style name Ziyue, was a native of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Lin, courtesy name Ziyue, was from Dongping.

sentences.zh: 大定二十五年進士，調符離主簿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed chief clerk at Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the twenty-fifth year of Dading and was appointed chief clerk at Fuli.

sentences.zh: 察廉，遷泗水令，再調安國軍節度判官。

translations.literal: Through an integrity inspection he was transferred to Magistrate of Sishui, and again appointed Military Commissioner's Judge of the Anguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Selected in an integrity review, he became Magistrate of Sishui, then Military Commissioner's Judge of the Anguo Army.

sentences.zh: 以父憂還鄉里，教授生徒，恆數百人。

translations.literal: He returned to his home district in mourning for his father and taught students, always numbering several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning his father, he returned home and taught students, regularly several hundred in number.

sentences.zh: 服除，為絳陽軍節度判官。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was Military Commissioner's Judge of the Jiangyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was Military Commissioner's Judge of the Jiangyang Army.

sentences.zh: 用薦舉，召為國史院編修官。

translations.literal: On recommendation he was summoned as Compiler in the Institute for National History.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended, he was summoned as Compiler in the Institute for National History.

sentences.zh: 建言：「黃河所以為民害者，皆以河流有曲折，適逢隘狹，故致湍決。

translations.literal: He submitted a proposal: "The Yellow River harms the people chiefly because the current has bends and, meeting narrow places, causes turbulent breaches.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed: "The Yellow River harms the people because its bends, where the channel meets narrow ground, cause violent breaches.

sentences.zh: 按《水經》當疏其厄塞，行所無事。

translations.literal: According to the Water Classic one should clear blockages so the flow may pass without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Water Classic, blockages should be cleared so the river may run unimpeded.

sentences.zh: 今若開雞爪河以殺其勢，可免數埽之勞。

translations.literal: If the Jizhua River is opened now to reduce its force, the labor of many embankment works can be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the Jizhua River now to bleed off its force could spare repeated embankment works.

sentences.zh: 凡卷埽工物，皆取於民，大為時病。

translations.literal: All materials for cofferdam and embankment work are taken from the people and are a great affliction of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Materials for cofferdams and embankments are levied on the people and have become a grave burden.

sentences.zh: 乞並河堤廣樹榆柳，數年之後，堤岸既固，埽材亦便，民力漸省。」

translations.literal: He asked to plant elms and willows widely along the river dike; after several years the banks would be firm and fascine materials convenient, and the people's labor would gradually be spared."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to plant elms and willows thickly along the dikes; in a few years the banks would hold firm, fascine timber would be at hand, and the people's labor would ease."

sentences.zh: 朝廷從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 遷應奉翰林文字兼前職，改監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Academician for Service with his former post, and made Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He became Hanlin Academician for Service while keeping his former post, then Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起複太常博士。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; on resumption he was appointed Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother he returned as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 改都水監丞，簽陝西路按察司事，體訪官員能否，仍赴闕待對。

translations.literal: He was made Vice Director of the Directorate of Waterways, signed matters for the Shaanxi Investigation Commission, inspected officials' competence, and then went to court to await audience.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Vice Director of the Directorate of Waterways, signed for the Shaanxi Investigation Commission, reviewed officials' competence, and went to court for audience.

sentences.zh: 時南徵調發繁急，民稍稽滯，有司皆坐失誤軍期罪。

translations.literal: At that time levies for the southern campaign were urgent and the people fell slightly behind; the authorities all punished them for missing military deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: Levies for the southern campaign were urgent; when people fell slightly behind, officials punished them for missing military deadlines.

sentences.zh: 霖言其枉，悉出之。

translations.literal: Lin said they were wronged and released them all.
translations.idiomatic: Lin said they had been wronged and released them all.

sentences.zh: 授都水少監。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Director of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 大安初，為耀州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was Prefect of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an he was Prefect of Yao.

sentences.zh: 三年，遷河北東路按察副使，改韓王傅，兼韓林直學士。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Hebei Eastern Route Investigation Commission, made Tutor of the Prince of Han with concurrent Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he became Vice Commissioner of the Hebei Eastern Route Investigation Commission, Tutor of the Prince of Han, and concurrent Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 崇慶初，改工部侍郎兼直學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongqing he was made Vice Minister of Works with concurrent Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongqing he was Vice Minister of Works and concurrent Academician.

sentences.zh: 至甯元年八月，霖奉儲偫迎宣宗至新城，敕霖南迎諸妃。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Zhi'ning, Lin, bearing stored provisions, met the Xuanzong Emperor at Xincheng; the emperor ordered Lin south to welcome the consorts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Zhi'ning, Lin brought stored provisions to meet the Xuanzong Emperor at Xincheng; the emperor ordered him south to welcome the imperial consorts.

sentences.zh: 既至，賜錢千貫，遷官三階。

translations.literal: When they arrived he was given a thousand strings of cash and promoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: After they arrived he received a thousand strings of cash and was promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，除河平軍節度使兼都水監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was made Military Commissioner of the Heping Army with concurrent directorship of the Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he became Military Commissioner of the Heping Army and concurrent Director of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 霖請城宜村為衛州以護北門，上從之。

translations.literal: Lin asked to fortify Yicun as Weizhou to guard the north gate; the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Lin asked to build Yicun into Weizhou to protect the north gate; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 入為兵部尚書，知大興府事，俄權參知政事，與右丞相承暉行省於中都。

translations.literal: He entered service as Minister of War and Administrator of Daxing Prefecture, and soon acted as Vice Councilor, joining the Right Chancellor Chenghui in directing affairs from Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: He became Minister of War and Administrator of Daxing Prefecture, then soon acted as Vice Councilor, joining Right Chancellor Chenghui in running affairs from Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 尋改中都留守，兼本路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: Shortly he was made Defender of Zhongdu with concurrent command of all military forces on that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Defender of Zhongdu and overall commander of the circuit's forces.

sentences.zh: 平章政事抹撚盡忠棄中都南奔，霖與子義傑率其徒夜出，不能進，謂義傑曰：「汝可求生，吾死於此矣。」

translations.literal: The Councilor Mozhan Jinzhong abandoned Zhongdu and fled south; Lin and his son Yijie led their followers out by night but could not advance, and Lin told Yijie: "You may seek to live; I shall die here."
translations.idiomatic: Councilor Mozhan Jinzhong abandoned Zhongdu and fled south; Lin and his son Yijie led their men out at night but could not get through, and Lin told Yijie: "Save yourself; I die here."

sentences.zh: 霖死，義傑伏群屍中以免。

translations.literal: Lin died; Yijie hid among the corpses and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Lin was killed; Yijie lay among the dead and survived.

sentences.zh: 贈翰林學士承旨，令立碑鄉里，歲時致祭，訪其子孫錄用，諡文簡。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Chief Hanlin Academician; an inscription was ordered in his home district with annual sacrifices, his descendants were sought out for appointment, and he was given the posthumous title Wénjiǎn.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Chief Hanlin Academician; a stele was ordered in his home district with yearly sacrifices, his descendants were sought for appointment, and he was given the posthumous title Wénjiǎn.

sentences.zh: 孟奎，字元秀，遼陽人也。

translations.literal: Meng Kui, style name Yuanxiu, was a native of Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Kui, courtesy name Yuanxiu, was from Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 大定二十一年進士，調黎陽主簿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed chief clerk at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the twenty-first year of Dading and was appointed chief clerk at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，調淄州軍事判官，遷汲縣令。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; when mourning ended he was appointed Military Judge of Zizhou and transferred to Magistrate of Jixian.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother he was Military Judge of Zizhou, then Magistrate of Jixian.

sentences.zh: 察廉，改定興令。

translations.literal: Through an integrity inspection he was changed to Magistrate of Dingxing.
translations.idiomatic: Selected in an integrity review, he became Magistrate of Dingxing.

sentences.zh: 補尚書省令史，從參知政事馬琪塞澶淵決河，改中都左警巡使。

translations.literal: He was appointed a clerk in the Secretariat and followed Vice Councilor Ma Qi to block the breach at Chanyuan on the Yellow River, then was made Left Patrol Commissioner of Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: He became a Secretariat clerk and followed Vice Councilor Ma Qi to seal the Chanyuan breach on the Yellow River, then was made Left Patrol Commissioner of Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 平章政事完顏守貞禮接士大夫在其門者，號「冷岩十俊」，奎其一也。

translations.literal: The Councilor Wanyan Shouzhen courteously received scholars at his gate and called them the "Ten Talents of Lengyan"; Kui was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: Councilor Wanyan Shouzhen welcomed scholars at his door and called them the "Ten Talents of Cold Cliff"; Kui was among them.

sentences.zh: 改都轉運司支度判官、上京等路提刑判官。

translations.literal: He was changed to Disbursement Judge of the Directorate General for Tax Transport and Investigating and Judicial Commissioner of the Shangjing and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He became Disbursement Judge of the Directorate General for Tax Transport and Investigating and Judicial Commissioner for Shangjing and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 初，遼東契丹判餘裏也嘗殺驛使大理司直，有契丹人同名者，有司輒系之獄，奎按囚速頻路讞而出之，既而果獲其殺司直者。

translations.literal: At first a Khitan of Liaodong named Panyuli had killed a relay courier who was a Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review; a Khitan with the same name was seized by the authorities, but Kui reviewed prisoners on the Supi Road and released him, and afterward they indeed caught the man who had killed the directing clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a Liaodong Khitan named Panyuli had killed a relay courier who was a Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review; officials seized a Khitan with the same name, but Kui reviewed prisoners on the Supi Road and released him—and later they did catch the killer of the directing clerk.

sentences.zh: 遷同知西京路轉運使事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Associate Commissioner of the Xijing Route Tax Transport.
translations.idiomatic: He became Associate Commissioner of the Xijing Route Tax Transport.

sentences.zh: 置行樞密院于鎮甯，充宣差規措所官給軍用。

translations.literal: When a mobile Bureau of Military Affairs was set up at Zhenning he was appointed an official of the Commissary for Planning to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: When a mobile Bureau of Military Affairs was established at Zhenning he served as an official of the Commissary for Planning, provisioning the army.

sentences.zh: 改簽河東南北路按察司事、武州刺史。

translations.literal: He was changed to signer of the Hedong North and South Route Investigation Commission and Prefect of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: He became signer of the Hedong North and South Route Investigation Commission and Prefect of Wu.

sentences.zh: 上言三事，其一曰親民之寄，「今吏部之選頗輕，使武夫計資而得，權歸胥吏。

translations.literal: He submitted three proposals; the first concerned the charge of caring for the people: "Selections by the Ministry of Personnel are now rather light, so that military men gain posts by counting seniority and power rests with clerks.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted three memorials; the first, on the trust of caring for the people, said: "The Ministry of Personnel's appointments are too casual: military men win posts by seniority alone, and clerks hold the real power.

sentences.zh: 每縣宜參用士人，使紀綱其事。」

translations.literal: Each county should employ scholars jointly so that they may uphold its affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Each county should employ scholars alongside officials so they can uphold local order."

sentences.zh: 未幾，改曹州刺史，再調同知中都路都轉運使事。

translations.literal: Before long he was made Prefect of Cao, and again transferred to Associate Commissioner of the Zhongdu Route Tax Transport.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Prefect of Cao, then Associate Commissioner of the Zhongdu Route Tax Transport.

sentences.zh: 旱，詔審錄中都路冤獄，多平反。

translations.literal: In a drought the emperor ordered review of wrongful cases on the Zhongdu circuit; many were reversed.
translations.idiomatic: During a drought the emperor ordered review of wrongful cases on the Zhongdu circuit; Kui reversed many of them.

sentences.zh: 大安初，除博州防禦使，凡屬縣事應赴州者，不得泊於逆旅，以防吏奸，人便之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was made Defender of Bozhou; all county business that should go to the prefecture might not lodge at inns, to prevent clerical abuse—the people found this convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an he became Defender of Bozhou; he forbade county business bound for the prefecture from stopping at inns, to block clerkly fraud, which helped the people.

sentences.zh: 改山東東西路安撫副使，遷北京、臨潢等路按察轉運使，以本官為行六部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Shandong East and West Route Pacification Commission, then Investigating and Transport Commissioner of Beijing, Linhuang, and other circuits, acting as Vice Minister of the Six Departments on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He became Vice Commissioner of the Shandong East and West Route Pacification Commission, then Investigating and Transport Commissioner for Beijing, Linhuang, and other circuits, acting as Vice Minister of the Six Departments on campaign.

sentences.zh: 劾奏監軍完顏訛出虛造功狀，訛出坐免官。

translations.literal: He impeached the military supervisor Wanyan Echu for fabricating merit records, and Echu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached military supervisor Wanyan Echu for inventing merit reports, and Echu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 詔以奎為宣差都提控。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Kui Commissary-in-Chief with full powers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Kui Commissary-in-Chief with full powers.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，以疾卒，諡莊肅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he died of illness and was given the posthumous title Zhuangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he died of illness and received the posthumous title Zhuangsu.

sentences.zh: 烏林答與

translations.literal: Wulindayu
translations.idiomatic: Wulindayu

sentences.zh: 烏林答與，本名合住，大名路納鄰必剌猛安人。

translations.literal: Wulindayu, original name Hezhu, was a native of Nalin Bila Meng'an in Daming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wulindayu, born Hezhu, came from Nalin Bila Meng'an in Daming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 充奉職、奉禦、尚食局直長，兼頓舍。

translations.literal: He served as Attendant-in-Attendance, Attendant-in-Attendance for the Imperial Household, and Chief of the Imperial Kitchen Bureau, with concurrent charge of lodging.
translations.idiomatic: He held posts as Attendant-in-Attendance and Attendant for the Imperial Household, became Chief of the Imperial Kitchen Bureau, and also supervised lodging.

sentences.zh: 除監察御史，累官武勝軍節度使、北京按察轉運使、太子詹事、武衛軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: He was made Investigating Censor and rose through posts to Military Commissioner of the Wusheng Army, Investigating and Transport Commissioner of Beijing, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and Commander of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Investigating Censor, he eventually became Military Commissioner of the Wusheng Army, Investigating and Transport Commissioner of Beijing, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and Commander of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，知東平府事，權宣撫副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was Administrator of Dongping Prefecture and acting Vice Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he governed Dongping Prefecture and acted as Vice Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改西安軍節度使，入為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was changed to Military Commissioner of the Xi'an Army and entered service as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He became Military Commissioner of the Xi'an Army and entered court as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 上言：「按察轉運司拘榷錢谷，糾彈非違，此平時之治法。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial: "The Investigation and Transport Commission controls and monopolizes money and grain and impeaches violations—this is governance for peacetime.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Investigation and Transport Commission seizes revenue, audits accounts, and impeaches wrongdoing—that is peacetime administration.

sentences.zh: 今四方兵動，民心未定，軍士動見刻削，乞權罷按察及勸農使。」

translations.literal: Now warfare stirs on all sides, the people's hearts are unsettled, and soldiers are constantly pared down; I beg that the Investigation Commission and the Agricultural Encouragement Commissioners be suspended for the time being."
translations.idiomatic: Now war rages everywhere, the people are unsettled, and soldiers face constant cuts; I ask that the Investigation Commission and the Agricultural Encouragement Commissioners be suspended for now."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「東平屯兵萬餘，可運濱鹽易糧芻給之。」

translations.literal: He also said: "More than ten thousand troops are stationed at Dongping; Binzhou salt could be transported to exchange for grain and fodder to supply them."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Dongping holds more than ten thousand troops; transport Binzhou salt and trade it for grain and fodder to feed them."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「潼關及黃河津要，將校皆出卒伍，類庸懦不可用。

translations.literal: He also said: "At Tong Pass and the Yellow River crossings the commanders are all drawn from the ranks and are mostly mediocre and cowardly and cannot be used.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "At Tong Pass and the Yellow River fords the garrison commanders are all promoted from the ranks—mostly timid and useless.

sentences.zh: 乞選材武者代之。」

translations.literal: I beg that men of talent and martial skill be chosen to replace them."
translations.idiomatic: Choose able and martial men to replace them."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「兗、曹、濮、浚諸郡皆可屯重兵，敕州縣官勸民力穡，至於防秋，則清野保城。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Yan, Cao, Pu, and Jun prefectures can all station heavy forces; order prefectural and county officials to urge the people to till the soil, and when autumn defense comes, clear the countryside and hold the cities."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Yan, Cao, Pu, and Jun can all hold large garrisons; order local officials to urge farming, and when autumn defense comes, strip the countryside and hold the walls."

sentences.zh: 下尚書省，竟不施行。

translations.literal: The memorial went to the Secretariat but in the end was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat received it, but nothing was implemented.

sentences.zh: 新制科買軍器材物稽緩者並的決，與奏：「有司必督責趣辦，民將不堪，可量罰月俸。」

translations.literal: Under a new regulation those who were slow in procuring military equipment were all punished by summary decision; he memorialized: "The authorities will surely press for haste and the people will not bear it; monthly salaries may be fined in proportion instead."
translations.idiomatic: A new rule punished delays in military procurement with summary beating; he memorialized: "Officials will only drive harder and the people cannot bear it—fine a portion of monthly salary instead."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 坐前在陝州市物虧直，降鄭州防禦使。

translations.literal: Because while previously in Shaanxi he had undervalued goods when purchasing for the state, he was demoted to Defender of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: For undervaluing state purchases while in Shaanxi he was demoted to Defender of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋召為拱衛直都指揮使，複為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Shortly he was summoned as Commander of the Palace Guard Direct and again made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled as Commander of the Palace Guard Direct and again made Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Xingding.

sentences.zh: 郭俁，字伯有，澤州人。

translations.literal: Guo Yu, style name Boyou, was a native of Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yu, courtesy name Boyou, was from Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 大定二十二年進士，調長子主簿、萊州觀察判官、萊陽縣令，補尚書省令史，知管差除。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed chief clerk at Changzi, Observer's Judge of Laizhou, and Magistrate of Laiyang; he was appointed a clerk in the Secretariat and managed roster assignments.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the twenty-second year of Dading, served as chief clerk at Changzi, Observer's Judge of Laizhou, and Magistrate of Laiyang, then became a Secretariat clerk in charge of appointments.

sentences.zh: 除大理司直。

translations.literal: He was made Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起複太常博士、左司都事。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; on resumption he was Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Director of the Left Department.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother he returned as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Director of the Left Department.

sentences.zh: 御史台舉俁及前應奉翰林文字張楫、吏部主事王質、刑部主事抹撚居中、通事舍人完顏合住、弘文校理把掃合、吏部架閣管勾烏古論和尚、尚書省令史溫蒂罕思敬皆才幹可用。

translations.literal: The Censorate recommended Yu and the former Hanlin Academician for Service Zhang Ji, Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Personnel Wang Zhi, Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Punishments Mozhan Juzhong, Imperial Protocol Officer Wanyan Hezhu, Collator of the Hongwen Academy Basao He, Records Supervisor in the Ministry of Personnel Wugulun Heshang, and Secretariat clerk Wendi Han Sijing as all capable and usable.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate recommended Yu, former Hanlin Academician for Service Zhang Ji, Ministry of Personnel Principal Clerk Wang Zhi, Ministry of Punishments Principal Clerk Mozhan Juzhong, Imperial Protocol Officer Wanyan Hezhu, Hongwen Collator Basao He, Ministry of Personnel Records Supervisor Wugulun Heshang, and Secretariat clerk Wendi Han Sijing as men of talent fit for service.

sentences.zh: 詔各升一等，遷除俁平陽府治中、張楫國子博士、王質昭義軍節度副使、抹撚居中大理司直、完顏合住侍儀司令、把掃合同知弘文院事、烏古論和尚利涉軍節度副使、溫蒂罕思敬同知定武軍節度事。

translations.literal: An edict promoted each one rank and appointed Yu Administrative Assistant of Pingyang Prefecture, Zhang Ji Erudite of the National University, Wang Zhi Vice Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, Mozhan Juzhong Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review, Wanyan Hezhu Director of the Ceremonial Guard, Basao He Associate Director of the Hongwen Academy, Wugulun Heshang Vice Military Commissioner of the Lishe Army, and Wendi Han Sijing Associate Military Commissioner of the Dingwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict raised each man one rank: Yu became Administrative Assistant of Pingyang, Zhang Ji National University Erudite, Wang Zhi Vice Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, Mozhan Juzhong Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review, Wanyan Hezhu Director of the Ceremonial Guard, Basao He Associate Director of the Hongwen Academy, Wugulun Heshang Vice Military Commissioner of the Lishe Army, and Wendi Han Sijing Associate Military Commissioner of the Dingwu Army.

sentences.zh: 久之，俁召為同知登聞鼓院兼秘書丞，遷禮部郎中、滕州刺史、同知真定府事。

translations.literal: After some time Yu was summoned as Associate Director of the Petition Drum Court with concurrent Secretary, then transferred to Director in the Ministry of Rites, Prefect of Tengzhou, and Associate Prefect of Zhending Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yu was called as Associate Director of the Petition Drum Court and concurrent Secretary, then became Director in the Ministry of Rites, Prefect of Tengzhou, and Associate Prefect of Zhending.

sentences.zh: 上言：「每季合注巡尉官，吏、刑兩部斟酌盜賊多寡處選注。」

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial: "Each season patrol and constable posts should be filled; the Ministries of Personnel and Punishments should weigh where banditry is heavy or light in choosing assignments."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Patrol and constable posts should be filled each quarter, with the Ministries of Personnel and Punishments assigning men according to local banditry."

sentences.zh: 詔議行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the plan discussed and adopted.

sentences.zh: 改中都、西京按察副使，遷國子祭酒。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Zhongdu and Xijing Investigation Commissions and promoted to Rector of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: He became Vice Commissioner of the Zhongdu and Xijing Investigation Commissions, then Rector of the National University.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年，伐宋，充宣差山東安撫副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe, when Song was attacked, he served as Vice Pacification Commissioner of Shandong on special commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Taihe, during the campaign against Song, he was Vice Pacification Commissioner of Shandong on special commission.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷山東宣撫副使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice Pacification Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became Vice Pacification Commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 大安元年，遷遼東按察轉運使，改中都路都轉運使、泰定軍節度使、陝西東路按察轉運使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Da'an he was transferred to Investigating and Transport Commissioner of Liaodong, then changed to Commissioner of the Zhongdu Route Tax Transport, Military Commissioner of the Taiding Army, and Investigating and Transport Commissioner of the Shaanxi Eastern Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Da'an he became Investigating and Transport Commissioner of Liaodong, then Commissioner of the Zhongdu Route Tax Transport, Military Commissioner of the Taiding Army, and Investigating and Transport Commissioner of the Shaanxi Eastern Route.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，罷按察司，仍充本路轉運使，行六部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou the Investigation Commission was abolished; he still served as Transport Commissioner on that circuit and acted as Minister of the Six Departments on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenyou the Investigation Commission was abolished; he remained Transport Commissioner on that circuit and acted as Minister of the Six Departments on campaign.

sentences.zh: 改河北西路轉運使，致仕。

translations.literal: He was changed to Transport Commissioner of the Hebei Western Route and retired.
translations.idiomatic: He became Transport Commissioner of the Hebei Western Route and retired.

sentences.zh: 元光二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanguang he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Yuanguang.

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕達

translations.literal: Wendi Handa
translations.idiomatic: Wendi Handa

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕達，字子達，本名謀古魯，蓋州按春猛安人。

translations.literal: Wendi Handa, style name Zida, original name Mogulu, was a native of Anchun Meng'an in Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wendi Handa, courtesy name Zida, born Mogulu, came from Anchun Meng'an in Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 性敦厚，寡言笑。

translations.literal: By nature he was sincere and thick and spoke and laughed little.
translations.idiomatic: He was sincere and reserved, seldom speaking or laughing.

sentences.zh: 初舉進士，廷試搜閱官易達藐小，謂之曰：「汝欲求作官邪？」

translations.literal: When he first took the jinshi examination, the examiner for the palace test Yi Da looked down on him for his small stature and said to him: "Do you wish to become an official?"
translations.idiomatic: At his first jinshi attempt, palace examiner Yi Da looked down on his slight build and said, "Do you want an office?"

sentences.zh: 達曰：「取人以才學，不以年貌。」

translations.literal: Handa said: "Men are chosen for talent and learning, not for age and looks."
translations.idiomatic: Handa replied, "Men are chosen for talent and learning, not for age or looks."

sentences.zh: 眾鹹異之。

translations.literal: The crowd all regarded him as extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly marveled at him.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年，中第，調固安主簿。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Mingchang he passed the examination and was appointed chief clerk at Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Mingchang he passed and was appointed chief clerk at Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 以憂去官，服除，調信州判官。

translations.literal: He left office in mourning; when mourning ended he was appointed Judge of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn; after mourning he was Judge of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丞相襄辟行省幕府。

translations.literal: Chancellor Xiang engaged him in the staff of the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Xiang took him onto the Pacification Commission staff.

sentences.zh: 改順州刺史，補尚書省令史，除南京警巡使。

translations.literal: He was changed to Prefect of Shunzhou, appointed a clerk in the Secretariat, and made Left Patrol Commissioner of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He became Prefect of Shunzhou, a Secretariat clerk, and Left Patrol Commissioner of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 居父喪，是時伐宋兵興，起複，給事行尚書省。

translations.literal: While mourning his father, when the campaign against Song began he was recalled from mourning and served in the Mobile Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning his father when war with Song began, he was recalled to serve in the Mobile Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大安初，遷德興府判官，再遷監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was transferred to Judge of Dexing Prefecture, then again to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an he was Judge of Dexing Prefecture, then Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 宣宗遷汴，以本職護送衛士妻子。

translations.literal: When the Xuanzong Emperor moved the capital to Bian, in his former post he escorted the guards' wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xuanzong Emperor moved the capital to Bian, he escorted the guards' families in his former post.

sentences.zh: 複被詔運大名粟，由禦河抵通州，事集，遷一官，轉戶部員外郎、左司郎中。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to transport grain from Daming by the Imperial River to Tongzhou; when the task was finished he was promoted one rank, transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue, and Left Department Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered to move Daming grain by the Imperial River to Tongzhou; when the task was done he was promoted one rank and made Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Left Department Director.

sentences.zh: 遇繼母憂，起複太常少卿，充陝西元帥府經歷官。

translations.literal: When his stepmother died he was recalled from mourning as Vice Minister of Rites and administrative officer of the Shaanxi Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning his stepmother, he was recalled as Vice Minister of Rites and administrative officer of the Shaanxi Marshal's Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，召還，攝侍御史，上疏論伐宋，略曰：「天時向暑，士馬不利，宜俟秋涼，無不可者。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding he was summoned back and acted as Attending Censor; he submitted a memorial on attacking Song, saying in summary: "The season tends toward heat and horses and men are unfit; wait until autumn is cool and nothing will be impossible."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding he was recalled and acted as Attending Censor; memorializing against attacking Song, he said in brief: "The season turns hot and troops and horses suffer—wait for cool autumn and all will be possible."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「遼東興王之地，移剌都不能守，走還南京。

translations.literal: He also said: "Liaodong is the land where the dynasty rose; Yila Dou could not hold it and fled back to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Liaodong is where the dynasty rose; Yila Dou could not hold it and fled back to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 度今之勢，可令濮王守純行省蓋州，駐兵合思罕，以系一方之心。

translations.literal: Judging the present situation, the Prince of Pu, Shouchun, could be sent to direct the Pacification Commission at Gaizhou and station troops at Hesihan to steady hearts in that region.
translations.idiomatic: Given present conditions, Prince Shouchun of Pu could run the Pacification Commission at Gaizhou and station troops at Hesihan to steady that region.

sentences.zh: 昔祖宗封建諸王，錯峙相維，以定大業。

translations.literal: In former times the ancestors enfeoffed the princes so they stood staggered and interlinked to secure the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Former emperors enfeoffed princes in staggered commands to secure the realm.

sentences.zh: 今乃委諸疏外，非計也。」

translations.literal: Now they are entrusted to distant margins—this is no plan."
translations.idiomatic: Now they are cast to the margins—that is no strategy."

sentences.zh: 宣宗曰：「一子非所愛，但幼不更事，詎能辦此？」

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor said: "It is not that I do not love this son, but he is young and inexperienced—how could he manage this?"
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor said, "It is not lack of love, but he is young and untested—how could he manage this?"

sentences.zh: 逾月，複上言：「天下輕重，系于宰相，邇來每令權攝，甚無謂也。

translations.literal: After more than a month he again submitted a memorial: "The weight of the realm rests on the chancellor; lately each has been ordered to act in an acting capacity, which is quite pointless.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he memorialized again: "The realm's weight rests on the chancellor, yet lately each is only acting—this is absurd.

sentences.zh: 今之將帥，謀者不能戰，戰者不能謀。

translations.literal: Today's commanders—those who plan cannot fight, and those who fight cannot plan.
translations.idiomatic: Today's generals: planners cannot fight, fighters cannot plan.

sentences.zh: 今豈無其人，但用之未盡耳。」

translations.literal: Are there truly no such men now? Only they have not been used to the full."
translations.idiomatic: Surely the men exist—they are simply not used fully."

sentences.zh: 宣宗曰：「人才難知，故先試其稱否，卿何患焉。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor said: "Talent is hard to know, so one first tests whether men fit their posts—why do you worry? Who are those not used to the full?
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor said, "Talent is hard to know, so we test men first—why worry? Whom do you mean by those not used fully?

sentences.zh: 所謂用之未盡者為誰？」

translations.literal: He replied:"
translations.idiomatic: He answered:"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「陝西統軍使把胡魯忠直幹略，知延安府古裏甲石倫深沉有謀，能得士心，雖有微過，不足以累大。」

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Commander Bahuru is upright and capable; Guli Jiasilun, who knows Yan'an Prefecture, is deep and resourceful and can win soldiers' hearts; though each has minor faults, they are not enough to harm great service."
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Commander Bahuru is upright and capable; Yan'an Prefect Guli Jiasilun is shrewd and wins soldiers' hearts; small faults should not bar great use."

sentences.zh: 宰相高琪、高汝勵惡其言。

translations.literal: The chancellors Gao Qi and Gao Runu hated his words.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors Gao Qi and Gao Runu resented his words.

sentences.zh: 俄充陝州行樞密院參議官。

translations.literal: Shortly he was made Councilor of the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs at Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Councilor of the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs at Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，召為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was recalled as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 改刑部，兼左司諫，同知集賢院。

translations.literal: He was changed to the Ministry of Punishments with concurrent Left Remonstrator and Associate Director of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to the Ministry of Punishments, with concurrent Left Remonstrator and Associate Director of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 改大理卿，兼越王傅。

translations.literal: He was changed to Chief Justice with concurrent Tutor of the Prince of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He became Chief Justice and Tutor of the Prince of Yue.

sentences.zh: 尋遷河南統軍使、昌武軍節度使，行六部，攝同簽樞密院，行院許州。

translations.literal: Shortly he was transferred to Commander of Henan, Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, acting Minister of the Six Departments, and acting signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs, directing the bureau from Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Commander of Henan, Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, acting Minister of the Six Departments, and acting signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 改集慶軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was changed to Military Commissioner of the Jiqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: He became Military Commissioner of the Jiqing Army.

sentences.zh: 是時，東方薦饑，達上疏曰：「亳州戶舊六萬，今存者無十一，何以為州？

translations.literal: At that time famine ravaged the east; Handa submitted a memorial: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; fewer than one in ten remain—how can it still be a prefecture?
translations.idiomatic: Famine scourged the east; Handa memorialized: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; fewer than one in ten remain—how can it remain a prefecture?

sentences.zh: 且今調發數倍於舊，乞量為減免。」

translations.literal: Moreover levies now are several times the old amount; I beg that they be reduced in proportion."
translations.idiomatic: Levies are now several times the old burden—I beg proportional relief."

sentences.zh: 是歲大水，碭山下邑野無居民，轉運司方憂兵食，達謾聞二縣無主稻田且萬頃，收可數萬斛，即具奏。

translations.literal: That year great floods came; below the Dang Mountains the county towns in the countryside had no inhabitants; the Transport Commission was just worrying over army provisions when Handa heard by rumor that two counties had ownerless paddy fields of nearly ten thousand mu yielding several tens of thousands of hu, and immediately memorialized in full.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods drowned the Dang Mountains region; countryside towns stood empty while the Transport Commission worried over army grain. Handa heard rumor of ten thousand mu of ownerless paddy in two counties yielding tens of thousands of hu and memorialized at once.

sentences.zh: 朝遷大駭，詔戶部尚書高夔佩虎符專治其事，所獲無幾，夔坐累抵罪。

translations.literal: The court was greatly alarmed and ordered Minister of Revenue Gao Kui, bearing a tiger tally, to take sole charge; what was obtained was very little and Kui was punished by accumulated offenses.
translations.idiomatic: The court was alarmed and sent Minister of Revenue Gao Kui with a tiger tally to take charge; the harvest was trifling and Kui was punished.

sentences.zh: 達自念失奏，因感愧發病，尋卒。

translations.literal: Handa, reflecting that his memorial had been wrong, fell ill from shame and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Handa, ashamed of his false report, fell ill and soon died.

sentences.zh: 王擴，字充之，中山永平人。

translations.literal: Wang Kuo, style name Chongzhi, was a native of Yongping in Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kuo, courtesy name Chongzhi, was from Yongping in Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年進士，調鄧州錄事，潤色律令文字。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Mingchang he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed Recorder of Dengzhou, polishing the wording of statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Mingchang and became Recorder of Dengzhou, refining statutory language.

sentences.zh: 遷懷安令。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Magistrate of Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: He became Magistrate of Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 猾吏張執中誣敗二令，擴到官，執中挈家避去。

translations.literal: The crafty clerk Zhang Zhizhong had falsely ruined two magistrates; when Kuo took office, Zhizhong moved his household and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The corrupt clerk Zhang Zhizhong had framed two magistrates; when Kuo arrived, Zhizhong fled with his family.

sentences.zh: 改徐州觀察判官，補尚書省令史，除同知德州防禦使事。

translations.literal: He was changed to Observer's Judge of Xuzhou, appointed a clerk in the Secretariat, and made Associate Defender of Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He became Observer's Judge of Xuzhou, a Secretariat clerk, and Associate Defender of Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 被詔賑貸山東西路饑民，棣州尤甚，擴輒限數外給之。

translations.literal: By imperial order he relieved famine in the Shandong East and West circuits; Di Prefecture suffered most severely and Kuo gave beyond the allotted quota.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to relieve famine on the Shandong East and West circuits, he gave beyond quota at Di Prefecture, which suffered worst.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，山東盜賊起，被安撫使張萬公牒提控督捕。

translations.literal: During the Taihe campaign against Song bandits rose in Shandong; by dispatch of Pacification Commissioner Zhang Wangong he was made Commissary to supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taihe attack on Song, bandits rose in Shandong; Pacification Commissioner Zhang Wangong commissioned him to supervise suppression.

sentences.zh: 擴行章丘道中，遇一男子舉止不常，捕訊，果曆城大盜也。

translations.literal: On the road through Zhangqiu, Kuo met a man whose bearing was unusual; he seized and questioned him, and the man proved to be a great bandit of Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling through Zhangqiu, Kuo seized a man of odd bearing; under questioning he proved to be a major Licheng bandit.

sentences.zh: 眾以為有神。

translations.literal: The crowd thought he had supernatural aid.
translations.idiomatic: People said he had uncanny judgment.

sentences.zh: 再遷監察御史，被詔詳讞冤獄。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Investigating Censor and ordered to review wrongful cases in detail.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Investigating Censor and ordered to review wrongful cases in detail.

sentences.zh: 是時，凡鬥殺奏決者，章宗輒減死，由是中外斷獄，皆以出罪為賢。

translations.literal: At that time in all cases of brawling and killing submitted for decision, Emperor Zhangzong always reduced the death sentence, and inside and outside the court in judging cases all took securing acquittal as merit.
translations.idiomatic: Then, in brawls ending in death, Emperor Zhangzong habitually commuted execution, and courts everywhere prized acquittal as virtue.

sentences.zh: 擴謂同輩曰：「生者既讞，地下之冤雲何！」

translations.literal: Kuo said to his colleagues: "The living have been judged—what of the wronged beneath the ground?"
translations.idiomatic: Kuo told colleagues, "You judge for the living—what of the dead who were wronged?"

sentences.zh: 是時，置三司治財，擴上書曰：「大定間，曹望之為戶部，財用殷阜，亦存乎人而已。

translations.literal: At that time the Three Departments for managing finances were set up; Kuo submitted a memorial: "In the Dading period Cao Wangzhi was in the Ministry of Revenue and funds were ample—it depended on the man alone.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Departments for finances were created, Kuo memorialized: "Under Dading, Cao Wangzhi in the Ministry of Revenue kept funds ample—it was the man that mattered.

sentences.zh: 今三司職掌，皆戶部舊式，其官乃戶部之舊官，其吏亦戶部之舊吏，何愚於戶部而智于三司乎？」

translations.literal: Now the duties of the Three Departments are all the old forms of the Ministry of Revenue; their officials are the old officials of the Ministry of Revenue and their clerks the old clerks—why was the Ministry of Revenue foolish and the Three Departments wise?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the Three Departments duplicate the Ministry of Revenue's old duties with its old officials and clerks—why was the ministry foolish and the Three Departments wise?"

sentences.zh: 既而三司亦竟罷。

translations.literal: Before long the Three Departments were also abolished in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Three Departments were abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 張煒職辦西北路糧草者數年，失亡多，尚書省奏擴考按，會煒亦舉王謙自代，王謙發其奸蠹，擴按之無所假借。

translations.literal: Zhang Wei had handled grain and fodder on the Northwest Route for several years with many losses; the Secretariat memorialized that Kuo should investigate; just then Wei also recommended Wang Qian to replace him, and Wang Qian exposed his corruption and fraud; Kuo investigated him without favor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wei had managed Northwest Route grain for years with heavy losses; the Secretariat ordered Kuo to investigate. Wei recommended Wang Qian as successor; Wang Qian exposed his fraud, and Kuo prosecuted without favor.

sentences.zh: 煒舊與擴厚，使人諉擴曰：「君不念同舍邪？」

translations.literal: Wei had long been on good terms with Kuo and sent someone to reproach Kuo: "Do you not remember our days as roommates?"
translations.idiomatic: Wei, once close to Kuo, sent a messenger: "Will you not remember our student days?"

sentences.zh: 擴曰：「既奉詔，安得顧故人哉！」

translations.literal: Kuo said: "Since I have received the edict, how can I consider an old friend?"
translations.idiomatic: Kuo said, "I have an edict—how can I favor an old friend?"

sentences.zh: 大安中，同知橫海軍節度事，簽河東北路按察事。

translations.literal: In Da'an he was Associate Military Commissioner of the Henghai Army and signer of the Hedong North Route Investigation Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Da'an he was Associate Military Commissioner of the Henghai Army and signer of the Hedong North Route Investigation Commission.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，上書陳河東守禦策，大概謂：「分軍守隘，兵散而不成軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he submitted a memorial setting forth the Hedong defense strategy, saying in summary: "Dividing forces to guard passes scatters the troops so they do not form an army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he memorialized on Hedong defense, saying in brief: "Splitting forces to hold passes scatters troops so they never form an army.

sentences.zh: 聚之隘內，軍合則勢重。

translations.literal: Gather them within the passes and when the army is united its momentum is heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Mass them inside the passes and united weight gathers.

sentences.zh: 饋餉一途，以逸待勞，以主待客，此上策也。」

translations.literal: One route for provisions, waiting at ease for the weary, host for guest—this is the superior strategy."
translations.idiomatic: One supply route, resting while the enemy wearies, defender facing attacker—that is the best strategy."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「軍校猥眾，分例過優，萬戶一員，其費可給兵士三十人。

translations.literal: He also said: "Military officers are numerous and their shares of pay excessively generous—one commander per ten-thousand-household unit, and his cost could supply thirty soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Officers are too many and pay shares too rich—one commander per ten-thousand-household unit could fund thirty soldiers.

sentences.zh: 本路三從宜，萬戶二百餘員，十羊九牧，類例可知。

translations.literal: On this circuit there are three commissioners with authority to act, and more than two hundred commanders of ten-thousand-household units—nine shepherds for ten sheep, as the proverb shows.
translations.idiomatic: This circuit has three commissioners with full powers and more than two hundred ten-thousand-household commanders—nine shepherds for ten sheep, as the saying goes.

sentences.zh: 乞以千人為一軍，擇望重者一人萬戶，兩猛安、四謀克足以教閱約束矣，豈不簡易而省費哉。」

translations.literal: I beg that a thousand men form one army, one man of standing be commander of ten thousand households, and two meng'an and four mukun suffice to drill and restrain them—would this not be simple and save expense?"
translations.idiomatic: Make a thousand men one army, one respected man commander per ten thousand households, two meng'an and four mukun enough to drill and restrain them—would that not be simpler and cheaper?"

sentences.zh: 又曰：「按察兼轉運，本欲假糾劾之權，以檢括錢谷。

translations.literal: He also said: "Making the Investigation Commissioner also Transport Commissioner was originally to borrow the power of impeachment to audit money and grain.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Combining Investigation and Transport was meant to use impeachment power to audit funds.

sentences.zh: 邇來軍興，糧道軍府得而制之。

translations.literal: Lately with warfare, grain routes and military prefectures can control them.
translations.idiomatic: Lately in war, supply offices and military prefectures control grain themselves.

sentences.zh: 今太原、代、嵐三軍皆其州府長官，如令通掌資儲，則弊立革，按察之職舉矣。」

translations.literal: Now the Taiyuan, Dai, and Lan armies are all under their prefectural and circuit chiefs; if they are ordered to manage stores jointly, abuses would be reformed at once and the Investigation Commissioner's duty fulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan, Dai, and Lan armies now answer to their prefects; if those chiefs jointly managed stores, abuse would end and Investigation work would be whole."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「數免租稅，科糴益繁，民不為恩，徒增廩給，教練無法，軍不足用。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Repeated tax exemptions multiply requisitioned grain purchases; the people feel no grace and only granaries swell; drill has no method and the army is not usable."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Repeated tax relief pairs with heavier requisitioned grain; the people feel no kindness while granaries swell; drill lacks method and armies cannot fight."

sentences.zh: 書奏，不見省。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted but not examined.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went up but drew no response.

sentences.zh: 遷汴後，召為戶部侍郎，遷南京路轉運使。

translations.literal: After the move to Bian he was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue and transferred to Transport Commissioner of the Nanjing Route.
translations.idiomatic: After the capital moved to Bian he became Vice Minister of Revenue, then Transport Commissioner of the Nanjing Route.

sentences.zh: 太府監奏羊瘦不可供禦。

translations.literal: The Imperial Storehouse Directorate memorialized that the sheep were thin and could not be supplied for the imperial table.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Storehouse reported the sheep too lean for the imperial table.

sentences.zh: 宣宗召擴詰問。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor summoned Kuo to question him.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor called Kuo to account.

sentences.zh: 擴奏曰：「官無羊，皆取於民，今民心未安，宜崇節儉。

translations.literal: Kuo memorialized: "The government has no sheep—all are taken from the people; the people's hearts are not yet settled and frugality should be honored.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo said: "The court has no sheep of its own—all come from the people; hearts are unsettled and the throne should model restraint.

sentences.zh: 廷議肥瘠紛紛，非所以示聖德也。」

translations.literal: Court debate over fat and lean is not how to display sagely virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Debating fat or lean in court is no way to show sagely virtue."

sentences.zh: 宣宗首肯之。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor nodded assent.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 平章政事高琪閱尚食物，謂擴曰：「聖主焦勞萬機，賴膳羞以安養，臣子宜盡心。」

translations.literal: Councilor Gao Qi inspected the imperial food and said to Kuo: "The sage ruler toils over myriad affairs and relies on delicacies for nourishment; ministers should give their utmost."
translations.idiomatic: Councilor Gao Qi inspected imperial provisions and told Kuo: "The sage ruler labors over every affair and depends on fine food for strength; ministers should give their all."

sentences.zh: 擴曰：「此自食監事，何勞宰相！」

translations.literal: Kuo said: "This is the food supervisors' affair—why trouble a chancellor!"
translations.idiomatic: Kuo said: "That is the food supervisors' business—why trouble a chancellor?"

sentences.zh: 高琪默然，銜之。

translations.literal: Gao Qi was silent and bore a grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi fell silent and resented him.

sentences.zh: 有司奪市人衣，以給往戍潼關軍士，京師大擾。

translations.literal: The authorities seized townspeople's clothing to supply soldiers going to garrison Tong Pass, and the capital was greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Officials seized townspeople's clothes for troops bound for Tong Pass, throwing the capital into uproar.

sentences.zh: 擴白宰相，請三日造之。

translations.literal: Kuo told the chancellor and asked for three days to make the garments.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo asked the chancellor for three days to produce the clothing.

sentences.zh: 高琪怒不從。

translations.literal: Gao Qi angrily refused.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi refused in anger.

sentences.zh: 潼關已破，大元兵至近郊，遣擴行六部事，規辦潼關芻糧。

translations.literal: Tong Pass had fallen and Great Yuan troops reached the suburbs; Kuo was sent to act as Minister of the Six Departments and plan fodder and grain for Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: After Tong Pass fell and Yuan forces neared the suburbs, Kuo was sent to act as Minister of the Six Departments and arrange Tong Pass grain and fodder.

sentences.zh: 偕戶部員外郎張好禮往商、虢，過中牟，不可進。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue Zhang Haoli he went toward Shang and Guo; passing Zhongmou they could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Director Zhang Haoli he headed for Shang and Guo but could not pass Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 高琪奏擴畏避，下吏論死。

translations.literal: Gao Qi memorialized that Kuo had shirked in fear and he was handed to the law officers for death.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi accused Kuo of cowardice and had him sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 宣宗薄其責，削兩階，杖七十，張好禮削三階，杖六十。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor lightened the blame, reduced him two ranks, and beat him seventy strokes; Zhang Haoli was reduced three ranks and beaten sixty.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor softened the penalty: Kuo lost two ranks and took seventy strokes; Zhang Haoli lost three ranks and took sixty.

sentences.zh: 降為遙授隴州防禦使，行六部侍郎，規辦秦、鞏軍食。

translations.literal: He was demoted to Defender of Longzhou on honorary appointment, acting Vice Minister of the Six Departments, planning army provisions for Qin and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to honorary Defender of Longzhou, acting Vice Minister of the Six Departments, provisioning Qin and Gong armies.

sentences.zh: 逾月，權陝西東路轉運使，行六部尚書。

translations.literal: After more than a month he acted as Transport Commissioner of the Shaanxi Eastern Route and acting Minister of the Six Departments.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he acted as Shaanxi Eastern Route Transport Commissioner and Minister of the Six Departments.

sentences.zh: 致仕。

translations.literal: He retired.
translations.idiomatic: He retired.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，卒，諡剛毅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding he died and was given the posthumous title Gangyi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Xingding and received the posthumous title Gangyi.

sentences.zh: 擴博學多才，梗直不容物，以是不振于時雲。

translations.literal: Kuo was broadly learned and talented, upright and intolerant, and for this did not flourish in his time.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo was learned and gifted but blunt and unyielding, and so never rose far in his age.

sentences.zh: 移剌福僧

translations.literal: Yila Fuseng
translations.idiomatic: Yila Fuseng

sentences.zh: 移剌福僧，東北路烏連苦河猛安人。

translations.literal: Yila Fuseng was a native of Wulian Kuhe Meng'an on the Northeast Route.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Fuseng came from Wulian Kuhe Meng'an on the Northeast Route.

sentences.zh: 以廕補吏部令史，轉樞密院，調滕州軍事判官，曆甄官署直長、豳王府司馬、順義軍節度副使。

translations.literal: By yin privilege he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Personnel, transferred to the Bureau of Military Affairs, appointed Military Judge of Tengzhou, and served in succession as Chief of the Selection Office, Marshal of the Prince of Bin's household, and Vice Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: By yin privilege he became a Ministry of Personnel clerk, moved to the Bureau of Military Affairs, served as Military Judge of Tengzhou, then as Selection Office chief, Marshal of the Prince of Bin's household, and Vice Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 部內世襲猛安木吞掠民婦女，藏之窟室，人頗聞之，無敢發其罪者。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction the hereditary meng'an Mutun seized commoners' women and hid them in a cave dwelling; people heard of it but none dared expose his crime.
translations.idiomatic: In his district the hereditary meng'an Mutun seized women and hid them in a cave; people knew but none dared accuse him.

sentences.zh: 福僧請于節度使，願自效，既跡得其所在，率眾入索之，得婦女四十三人，木吞抵罪。

translations.literal: Fuseng asked the military commissioner and volunteered; once he traced the place he led men in to search and recovered forty-three women; Mutun was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Fuseng asked the military commissioner to act, traced the hideout, led men in, recovered forty-three women, and punished Mutun.

sentences.zh: 徙橫海軍，轉同知開遠軍節度事，簽北京、臨潢按察事，興中治中，莫州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Henghai Army, then Associate Military Commissioner of the Kaiyuan Army, signer of the Beijing and Linhuang Investigation Commission, Administrative Assistant of Xingzhong, and Prefect of Mo.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to the Henghai Army, became Associate Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan, signed for Beijing and Linhuang investigations, served as Administrative Assistant of Xingzhong, and Prefect of Mo.

sentences.zh: 上言：「沿邊軍官私役軍人，邊防不治，及擾動等事，按察司專一體究，各路宣差提控嚴勒禁治。」

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial: "Along the frontier, officers who privately employ soldiers, leave border defense untended, and cause disturbances—the Investigation Commission should investigate exclusively, and special commissioners on each route should strictly forbid and correct it."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Frontier officers who press soldiers into private service, neglect defense, and stir trouble should be investigated solely by the Investigation Commission, with route commissioners enforcing strict bans."

sentences.zh: 詔尚書省行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Secretariat to implement it.

sentences.zh: 大安初，改沃州，同知興中府事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was changed to Wo Prefecture and Associate Prefect of Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an he governed Wo Prefecture and served as Associate Prefect of Xingzhong.

sentences.zh: 福僧督民繕治城郭，浚濠為禦守備，百姓頗怨。

translations.literal: Fuseng urged the people to repair walls and dredge moats for defense; the common people were much resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Fuseng pressed people to repair walls and moats; they resented the labor.

sentences.zh: 頃之，兵果至，攻其北城。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward troops did arrive and attacked the north wall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon enemy troops came and struck the north wall.

sentences.zh: 福僧戰其北，使備其西，薄暮果攻其西，以有備乃解去。

translations.literal: Fuseng fought on the north and ordered preparations on the west; at dusk they indeed attacked the west, but finding preparations withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fuseng fought in the north while readying the west; at dusk the enemy struck west, found defenses ready, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 尋改廣寧。

translations.literal: Shortly he was changed to Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Guangning.

sentences.zh: 崇慶元年秋，福僧被牒如鄰郡，大兵薄城，其子銅和尚率家奴拒戰，廣甯賴之以完。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Chongqing, Fuseng was summoned by dispatch to a neighboring prefecture; when great forces pressed the city his son Tongheshang led household slaves to resist and Guangning was preserved thereby.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the first year of Chongqing, Fuseng was called to a neighboring prefecture; when enemy forces neared Guangning, his son Tongheshang led household slaves to fight and saved the city.

sentences.zh: 福僧還，悉放奴為良，終不言子之功，識者多之。

translations.literal: When Fuseng returned he released all the slaves as commoners and never spoke of his son's merit; those who knew praised him.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he freed all slaves as commoners and never mentioned his son's deed; observers admired him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，充遼東宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Before long he served as Vice Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Vice Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 歲大饑，福僧出沿海倉粟，先賑其民，而後奏之，優詔獎諭。

translations.literal: In a year of great famine Fuseng released coastal granary grain, first relieving his people and then memorializing; a gracious edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In famine he opened coastal granaries, fed his people first, then reported; the court praised him warmly.

sentences.zh: 至甯元年，除鞏王傅兼吏部郎中。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhi'ning he was made Tutor of the Prince of Gong with concurrent Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhi'ning he became Tutor of the Prince of Gong and Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 胡沙虎作難，福僧稱疾不出。

translations.literal: When Hushahu made trouble Fuseng claimed illness and did not appear.
translations.idiomatic: When Hushahu rebelled Fuseng feigned illness and stayed away.

sentences.zh: 宣宗封胡沙虎澤王，百官皆賀，福僧不往，胡沙虎欲摭而罪之。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor enfeoffed Hushahu as Prince of Ze; all officials congratulated him but Fuseng did not go; Hushahu wished to seize on faults and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor made Hushahu Prince of Ze; officials congratulated him but Fuseng stayed away, and Hushahu sought a pretext to punish him.

sentences.zh: 詔除福僧壽州防禦使。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Fuseng Defender of Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made him Defender of Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，遷山東西路按察轉運使。
